qs.q: Which of the following is a nephrotoxic cause of Acute Tubular Injury (ATI)?
qs.e: Gentamicin is listed as an exogenous nephrotoxic agent causing ATI. Sepsis, trauma, and burns are listed as causes of ischemic ATI.
